investigations.name: full-corpus-reproduction
investigations.description: This is the full-corpus reproduction run. The batch-compare-biomodels composite fetches each model's SBML, parses every SED-ML simulation, runs each engine over all jobs, and reports all-pairs nRMSE per (model, SED-ML doc). Executed over the whole corpus with viva_biomodels.ray_runner (one Ray task per model, crash-isolated). The result — 1008 models, up to five engines each, 14.7M rows — is committed at datasets/corpus_all_engines/ (a sorted tidy parquet + a compact per-model index.json) and served to the corpus explorer (Analyses tab) as one JSON per model for lazy, model-by-model browsing.
investigations.title: Full BioModels reproduction across all simulators (1008 models × 5 engines)
investigations.objective: Across the entire BioModels corpus, do independent simulators (COPASI, Tellurium, simbio, AMICI, PySCeS) reproduce the same trajectories, and where do they diverge?
investigations.claim: Running the full BioModels corpus through the batch-compare-biomodels composite under up to five independent ODE engines reproduces 1008 models (14.7M timecourse rows); 306 models are covered by all five engines and 725 by four or more. The complete per-model, per-engine result is committed and browsable model-by-model in the corpus explorer.
